cases.title: The Pit Schedule lists P1, P2 ... P7, P9, P10 in number order and never puts P10 before P1 or P2
cases.plan_item: UX-SCHED-06 basic natural order (daily card D21)
cases.expected: PITSCHEDULE on the untouched copy lists the pit rows Pit P1, Pit P2, Pit P3, Pit P4, Pit P5, Pit P6, Pit P7, Pit P9 and Pit P10 in that order from top to bottom; no Pit P10 row comes before the Pit P1 or Pit P2 row; the Close button closes the window.
cases.why_not_unit: The order shown depends on the live window reading the real pits of the drawing.
not_automated: The refinement P1A straight after P1 and SPS2 before SPS10 is behind linking.pitScheduleNaturalOrder (OFF) and needs a fixture with such names: not tested.
The group order LPD, OG, P, CP, then the rest is RECORDED (the full row list), not asserted.
Pits placed new in the session (card steps 1 to 3) are not used; the fixture's own P9 and P10 prove the same sorting rule.
